answer: A practical defence is Signed farm tenancy record with land agent attestation. It rests on a tenancy the agent recorded across years of fields, which gives every honest agent a delta that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a tenancy the agent recorded across years of fields — so privacy survives, and the knoll is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. A farm doing the maths finds the forge first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one.
